create_sqs_logger: create an SQS logger instance to batch and send litellm logging payloads to an AWS SQS queue
test_sqs_health: test the SQS logger health check by sending a minimal test message to the configured queue
build_sqs_encrypted_logger: build an SQS logger with application-level encryption using a base64-encoded key and optional additional authenticated data
review_sqs_strip_base64: review the SQS logger's base64 stripping capability to reduce payload size by removing inline base64-encoded files
summarize_sqs_logging: summarize how the SQS logger batches StandardLoggingPayload entries and sends them via signed AWS requests
